summary.text: Logan Patberg is the Democratic candidate for the Indiana House of Representatives, District 76, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Wendy McNamara.
A public school teacher in the Evansville Vanderburgh School Corporation, he lists affordability, education and healthcare costs among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Logan Patberg said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a father, educator and lifelong resident of Southwestern Indiana.

He said he spent a decade working in the automotive and agricultural industries before becoming a public school educator in the Evansville Vanderburgh School Corporation, and that he serves on the board of the Evansville Teachers Association.
Patberg advanced from the Democratic primary for District 76 on May 5, 2026, without a primary opponent.
In his survey, he said the top priority of his campaign is affordability for working Hoosiers, including the cost of groceries, energy, housing, childcare and healthcare.
He also said he wants to bring down prescription costs and to support K-12 public education with resources for students, support for educators and adequate funding for schools.
He listed 314 Action as an endorser.
